news.headline: Dell Technologies Launches New Range of Business Headsets
news.summary: Dell Technologies has introduced a new portfolio of five business headsets, including wireless and wired models, designed for modern workplace environments.

news.headline: Oracle Introduces Life Sciences AI Agents for Clinical Trials
news.summary: Oracle has launched a new agentic AI experience designed to assist life sciences organizations in coordinating and managing clinical trial operations.

news.headline: Oracle Launches New AI Capabilities for Primavera Cloud
news.summary: Oracle has introduced new artificial intelligence features for its Primavera Cloud service to assist construction teams with project planning and risk management.

news.headline: CISA Issues Advisory for Critical Oracle Java Vulnerability
news.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has issued an advisory urging organizations to immediately patch a critical memory-corruption vulnerability in Oracle Java.
